text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Quantile score of the probabilistic forecast over all leads, in points of the substation's capacity. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months and seeds. The intervals are wide because every arm's error rises and falls together by month; the paired contrasts in figure 2 are narrower.'
